title: alcea pallida subsp. cretica
intro: Alcea pallida subsp. cretica, commonly known as the Balkan hollyhock, is a subspecies of plant within the mallow family (Malvaceae), native to the Balkan Peninsula. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage. The therapeutic actions of Alcea pallida subsp. cretica include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, making it useful for treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
